// Services

My Services

Things I can build for you, end to end — from the first sketch to something shipped and working.

// 01 — Game creation

Game Development

I design and build games from concept to playable product — mobile, desktop, or VR. Fun and functional are both non-negotiable.

  • Game design tailored to your vision
  • Interactive, scalable game development
  • Art & animation for an immersive feel
  • Thorough testing & QA
  • Launch support and post-launch fixes

// 02 — Frontend web

Website Development

Fast, responsive websites that look right on every screen and load quickly. Built to help your project stand out online.

  • UI/UX design with the user in mind
  • Responsive layouts for all devices
  • Performance optimisation
  • SEO-friendly structure

// 03 — Hardware

PCB Design

Custom PCB design for your electronics projects — from prototype to production-ready boards, optimised and well-routed.

  • Schematic design, clean and well-structured
  • Board layout tuned for reliability
  • Component selection (cost / efficiency / availability)
  • Prototyping & design verification
  • Fabrication and assembly support

// 04 — Full stack apps

App Development

Cross-platform apps built with Flutter and Dart, backed by Firebase — from design to Play Store, backend included.

  • Flutter / Dart cross-platform development
  • Firebase backends: auth, database, analytics
  • API design & integration
  • Play Store publishing & maintenance
